<b>{{PAGENAME}}s</b> are [[church]]-related consumables, able to be used in any of the available [[candelabra]]s, in order to provide a temporary increase in {{Church Rating}} Church Quality. There are multiple types of candles, each providing a bonus; the more expensive or complex the candle, the greater the bonus. As higher-tier candelabras each have more candle slots, one would need enough candles of a single type in order to activate the given candelabra.
